entries.name: CubeSmart
entries.service_area_detail: Nationwide, ~1,500 owned/managed stores in 40+ states and DC
entries.phone_pay_by_phone: 1-855-535-5785 (automated payment line; contact page also lists Bill Pay 1-888-645-8236)

entries.notes: FAQ page explains ACH AutoPay (no fee), card AutoPay and one-time payments (3% convenience fee online/phone), in-store cash/check payments with no fee, online bill pay via Customer Center; seriously past-due accounts must call the store. Contact page: https://www.cubesmart.com/about-us/contact-us/. Mobile App page (https://www.cubesmart.com/mobileapp/) says the app shows account balances and payment history, pays bills and sets up AutoPay; app help line 833-940-2949. Fee Schedule (https://www.cubesmart.com/feeschedule) lists by state the admin rental fee ($29), $1/month admin invoice fee, late fees (e.g. AL $10 on day 6 and day 16; AZ greater of $10 or 20% of rent on day 11), Administrative Lien Fee ($110 if rent unpaid by day 30) and $30 NSF fee; ACH AutoPay and in-store payments carry no fee, card AutoPay/online/phone payments carry a 3% convenience fee. FAQ: rent changes are noticed 30 days in advance by mail or certified e-mail; move-out notice appreciated but not required (month-to-month); seriously past-due accounts must call the store. No public autopay-cancel how-to; manage AutoPay in Customer Center/app or call. Active-duty military discount only; no senior or hardship program published. The FAQ was re-read live through WebFetch. It confirms: rent is due on the move-in day each month; ACH AutoPay has no convenience fee and card AutoPay carries a 3% fee; you can pay in the Customer Center (mycube.cubesmart.com), in the app, in store, or on the automated line 855-535-5785; general line 1-877-279-7585. It still has no cancel-AutoPay steps; turn it off in the Customer Center or app, or ask the store.

entries.name: Dignity Memorial (Service Corporation International) pre-need funeral & cemetery contracts
entries.service_area_detail: Nationwide: ~1,500 funeral homes and ~500 cemeteries across 44 states and DC under Dignity Memorial and local brand names (e.g., National Cremation Society, Neptune Society, Trident Society are SCI brands)
entries.payment_processor: SCI-hosted 'Dignity Memorial Online Bill Pay & Secure Account Management' portal
entries.senior_programs: Pre-need plans are typically paid in monthly installments; payment plan terms, autopay and cancellation rights vary by state preneed law and contract.
entries.notes: Pre-planning info: https://www.dignitymemorial.com/pre-planning/prepaid-funeral-plans. Site is Cloudflare-protected. For autopay and statement instructions, call 800-343-4464 or the local location. Monthly payment plans are available for pre-need contracts. Pay online at pay.dignitymemorial.com or call 800-343-4464. Contact form has a billing/payment-information option. Crown Hill (Indianapolis), Evergreen-Washelli (Seattle), Wasatch Lawn (Salt Lake) and Lake Lawn Metairie (New Orleans) websites now redirect to Dignity Memorial location pages, so their contracts are paid through Dignity Memorial bill pay. It describes paying for prearranged funeral, cremation or cemetery plans in monthly installments and links 'Bill Pay'. It publishes no interest, autopay or cancellation terms. SCI brands run their own copies of the same 'Online Bill Pay & Secure Account Management' portal: pay.rosehills.com, pay.neptunesociety.com, pay.nationalcremation.com and pay.tridentsociety.com. Families should pay at the brand named on their contract. pay.dignitymemorial.com is Dignity Memorial Online Bill Pay & Secure Account Management. The contact page offers Billing / Payment Information requests through the 24/7 line 800-343-4464. The payment-plan page gives no interest rate, term or autopay details.

entries.name: Everstory Partners (formerly StoneMor Inc.) cemeteries and funeral homes
entries.service_area_detail: ~300 cemeteries and ~70 funeral homes in ~25 states and Puerto Rico (largest concentration PA, NJ, OH, VA, WV, NC, FL, CA)
entries.phone_customer_service: 844-808-3310 (MemorialPlanning.com "Need assistance?" line); for account help the page directs you to your Family Service Counselor or serving location
entries.payment_processor: Paymentus (customer payment platform at ipn4.paymentus.com/cp/evst; My Account on MemorialPlanning.com)
entries.notes: Corporate site offers only a contact form; pre-need/cemetery installment payments are handled through the local cemetery or funeral home named on the contract (location sites). stonemor.com no longer resolves. Payments go through the local location or the channels above. Payment Platform Update page (https://memorialplanning.com/payment-platform-update/): contract terms, amount and due date unchanged; create a new profile and link the account (account number, last name, ZIP); one-time guest Pay Now; payment history, saved wallet and AutoPay are in the platform; existing ACH AutoPay carried over automatically, but card AutoPay must be re-enrolled (manage/stop AutoPay in the AutoPay section of the same platform); 3% surcharge on credit cards (2% in CO, none in PR), no fee for debit or eCheck; multiple contracts per profile; monthly statements continue. Step-by-step PDFs: enrollment (https://memorialplanning.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Everstory-Customer-Portal-Guide-4.pdf), AutoPay (https://memorialplanning.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Autopay-Guide-Customer-Payment-Platform.pdf), wallet and make-a-payment guides. Help: the Family Service Counselor or the location serving the account. The Archdiocese of Philadelphia Catholic cemeteries use the same platform. Re-read the Payment Platform Update page. It says you can manage payments online, including AutoPay enrollment, payment history and saved payment methods. Neither that page nor the AutoPay PDF gives explicit steps to cancel AutoPay. To be sure AutoPay is stopped, call the serving location or 844-808-3310.

entries.notes: Current-customer FAQ page covers payment options (online via My Account, phone 888-STORAGE, mail, in-store cash/check/card), Easy Pay automatic payments (My Account > Pay Online > Easy Pay tab, or Easy Pay form at the facility), late fees (charged 5 days after missed due date), autopay failure notifications. Contact page: https://www.extraspace.com/help/contact/. Use My Account or call. Replaced anchor links with the individual FAQ articles (payment options: store, online, phone 888-STORAGE, mailed check; Easy Pay setup via My Account > Pay Online > Easy Pay tab or facility form; My Account portal: one-time payments, autopay enrollment). Autopay failure FAQ: https://www.extraspace.com/self-storage/faq/what-happens-if-my-auto-pay-fails/. Email opt-out FAQ: https://www.extraspace.com/self-storage/faq/how-can-i-change-my-email-options/. Still no public article on cancelling Easy Pay or viewing past statements. Storageexpress.com redirects to extraspace.com/storage-express/ and lifestorage.com to extraspace.com. Extra Space FAQ pages: What Happens If My Automatic Payment Fails? (https://www.extraspace.com/self-storage/faq/what-happens-if-my-auto-pay-fails/) and Can I enter my storage unit if my balance is past due? To stop Easy Pay, use My Account > Pay Online > Easy Pay or call the facility / 1-888-609-8483. Pay online in My Account, by phone 888-STORAGE, by mail, or in store (cash, check, card); Easy Pay set up in My Account > Pay Online > Easy Pay tab or by a facility form; late fees are charged 5 days after a missed due date and cannot be waived, gate access is removed and the unit over-locked until paid in full; failed autopay is retried for 3 days and must be fixed within 5 days of the due date to avoid a late fee; auction timing follows state law after written notice, sale proceeds are applied to the balance (surplus refunded by check, shortfall sent to collections). Late-payment FAQ: https://www.extraspace.com/self-storage/faq/what-happens-if-im-late-making-a-payment/; auction FAQ: https://www.extraspace.com/self-storage/faq/how-long-after-my-account-is-delinquent-will-my-belongings-go-to-auction/; move-out notice FAQ: https://www.extraspace.com/self-storage/faq/how-much-notice-is-required-to-move-out/. No public Easy Pay cancel or statement-history article exists; stop Easy Pay in My Account or call 888-609-8483. The ezstorage.com domain now redirects to publicstorage.com (see Public Storage).
